rows.label: tlk70000138_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm from Iira. Born and
raised in the capital.

rows.label: tlk70000138_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I can't stand my eccentric father, so
I ran away from home and just became a
helmsman.

rows.label: tlk70000138_02_msg0006
rows.name: The air in Gula is great...

rows.label: tlk70000138_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Iira has lots of forests, but around
the capital it's mostly desert, so the
sand and dust get to me.

rows.label: tlk70000138_02_msg0008
rows.name:
Being a helmsman lets me visit all
kinds of countries, so it's fun.
